title: aw-wayfinder, the last ticket clears the map
source: #55: it never builds, and ends by naming /aw-spec for each deliverable. The map is a fixture with one open ticket

answers.when: In what order reservations are served
answers.intent: First come, first served: the oldest reservation of a book goes first
answers.reason: a HITL ticket resolves only through the person

answers.when: What serving a reservation means: what happens to the first reservation when the book comes back
answers.intent: Nothing happens on its own: the queue only orders the reservations, and the listing shows that order. Whoever borrows the book first gets it, as today, with no hold set aside
answers.reason: keeps reserve-book to one small slice: a hold would bring expiry and hand-over rules that the rest of the batch builds in one slice

answers.when: Whether a hold expires, or what happens when the first member in the queue cannot borrow
answers.intent: There is no hold, so nothing expires or passes on
answers.reason: keeps reserve-book to one small slice: a hold would bring expiry and hand-over rules that the rest of the batch builds in one slice

answers.when: What happens when a member cancels, or cancels and reserves again
answers.intent: The reservation leaves the queue and the ones behind it move up; reserving again joins at the end
answers.reason: settles what cancel-reservation needs, so no new ticket opens

answers.when: Whether the answer opens another decision
answers.intent: No, nothing else is left to decide
answers.reason: this ticket must clear the map

answers.when: Which deliverables there are, and the order to spec them in
answers.intent: The two the destination names, reserve-book first and then cancel-reservation
answers.reason: the hand-off must name /aw-spec for each

assertions.name: no code or test changed
assertions.run: git diff --exit-code origin/main HEAD -- src tests

assertions.judge: Resolved only the open ticket, with the answer the person gave
Ended by naming /aw-spec once for each deliverable, naming the deliverable and the map, and did not run it
